cases.goal: A PRD already has clear problem, actor, outcome, scope and acceptance.
expected: does not invent another blocking question
penalize: asks more than three primary questions

cases.goal: The problem statement says the company needs Kafka but gives no observed user or delivery problem.
expected: asks for underlying outcome or evidence
penalize: accepts Kafka as a product requirement without rationale

cases.goal: An existing Postgres service already has an outbox; a proposed SDD adds Kafka only for scalability.
expected: recommends existing mechanism unless a missing constraint justifies Kafka
asks only about material delivery or ownership constraints

cases.goal: A secret-rotation design permits concurrent rotation but does not define active-key selection or atomicity.
expected: reports a blocker or required decision about the invariant
explains why concurrent outcomes are ambiguous
penalize: treats the issue as a suggestion

cases.goal: An internal pure calculation refactor changes no data boundary, permissions, inputs, or dependencies.
expected: does not require a security section
